item.title: Avoid API Breaking Changes
item.description: Have you ever changed your backing data model and then all of a sudden all your clients explode? It’s not because you broke your code. You broke your contract. Most times API breaking changes occur because you’re exposing your domain model or data model. You’re not just sharing data. You’re leaking implementation details.
